## Summary

- gate the Rust provider, transport, search, CLI, and server stack behind the existing default `server` feature
- keep `SearchResult` and deterministic merge APIs available with `default-features = false`
- add a dependency-graph regression check and CI coverage for the lightweight merge-only build
- document merge-only installation and add the Rust minor-release changelog fragment

## Reproduction

Before this change, `cargo tree --no-default-features --edges normal` still included Axum, Reqwest, Tokio, `web-capture`, and OpenSSL because the runtime dependencies and modules were unconditional.

The new `check-core-feature-boundary.rs` regression check failed against that dependency graph before the implementation and now passes.

## Verification

- `cargo check --no-default-features --lib --verbose`
- `cargo test --no-default-features --lib` (2 passed)
- `rust-script rust/scripts/check-core-feature-boundary.rs --rust-root rust`
- `cargo test --all-features --verbose` (43 passed)
- `cargo test --doc` (1 passed)
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features`
- `cargo package --list --allow-dirty`
- Rust changelog, file-size, and crate-size policy checks
- `npm test` (161 passed)
- `npm run check`
- `node js/scripts/check-js-rust-parity.mjs`

No screenshots are applicable because this change has no UI surface.

Fixes #22
title: Make Rust merge-only builds independent of server dependencies
